summary.summary: Belfast has a usable MVP event catalog from local planning statistics, official public project pages, and OSM mapped-event metadata. Coverage is strongest for 2016-2026 local replay context, with OSM mapped-event metadata extending back to 2007 and thinner official source-backed completions.

matrix.label: Planning and development records
matrix.notes: Local CSV extracts support decision records. They are evidence of planning decisions, not proof of completed construction.

matrix.label: OpenStreetMap mapped infrastructure history
matrix.notes: Existing Belfast infrastructure records preserve OSM timestamps and changesets from 2007 onward. These are mapped visibility dates, not real-world construction dates.

matrix.label: Transport stations, routes, and public project pages
matrix.notes: Official pages and local Translink files support named station/service events and current route context.

matrix.label: Council services and facilities
matrix.notes: Open-data facility lists and public pages support civic-service context where licence and attribution are retained.

matrix.label: Population, census, deprivation, and statistical boundaries
matrix.notes: Recommended for context layers and denominators. New adapters should preserve official geography codes.

matrix.label: Air quality, green space, and environmental context
matrix.notes: Useful for observed context. Do not infer causal impacts from proximity alone.
